CivilizationInfo.Civilopedia: The Loveland Frog (otherwise known as the Loveland Lizard) is said to be a human-like creature with the face of a frog and is described as standing roughly 4 feet (1.2 m) tall with green leathery skin. It walks upright and has webbed hands and feet, and was allegedly first spotted in Loveland, Ohio. It is generally considered a cryptid, a creature rumored or reported to be living, but with no confirmable proof.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The first claimed sighting was in May 1955. A businessman is said to have seen three or four 3-foot (0.91 m)-tall frog-faced creatures squatting under a bridge near Loveland. They were described as having wrinkles instead of hair on their heads, lopsided chests, and wide mouths without lips, like frogs. One of them is said to have held up a bar device that shed sparks. A strong odor of alfalfa and almonds was reportedly left behind. For approximately twenty years, there were no further reported sightings of the Loveland Frog. On March 3, 1972, police are said to have seen a four-foot-tall frog-faced human-like creature with leathery skin, again near Loveland. It jumped over a rail and into the Little Miami River. Two weeks later, officer Mark Mathews saw it again, lying in the road. It got away as Mathews shot at it and apparently missed. The officer's description was reported as follows: The creature was three to four feet tall, 50 to 75 pounds, leathery skin, possibly wet - matted hair on its body that made it look textured, possible tail, a head and face like a frog or lizard, and could leap over the roads' guard rail.

In the chaos surrounding the near-collapse of the petrochemical industry, much of the Islamic world has fallen under the sway of the Restored Caliphate, ruled by an extensive cabal of reactionary Muslim clerics. Encompassing vast areas from North Africa and the Middle East to fragments of the Indonesian archipelago, the largely Shiite theocracy clings to power with the aid of a brutally repressive inquisition, embroiled in a constant struggle to maintain control over restive Sunni and nationalist movements in its diverse population.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Caliphate soldiers are motivated by a fanatical desire to spread the word of the Prophet across both Earth and space. Maintaining a near-monopoly over Earth's shrinking oil market in the face of a continuing transition to fusion energy, all Caliphate colonies start with a functioning Power Plant.

In a bid to shield themselves from increasing taxation and regulation at the hands of the rapidly expanding Earth governments, many the largest megacorporations of Earth have fused into a nebulous quasi-national entity known as the Consortium. After targeted economic pressure and the judicious use of mercenaries forced the creation of so-called "enterprise zones" within the decaying superpowers, the Consortium now exerts de-facto control over a variety of financial megacenters including Hong Kong, Manhattan, Singapore, Sao Paulo, Zurich, and Dubai, as well as a diversified portfolio of Third World puppet governments.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The vast and flexible markets of the Enterprise Zones surpass even those of Russia; though Consortium management sees its colonies as nothing more than a profit center, and exacts a heavy tax in the form of constant dividends. With sophisticated distribution centers capable of sourcing a variety of goods, each Consortium colony starts with a free Warehouse.

The Cyeans are known throughout the various species of the New Worlds for their commitment to scholarship and aversion to initiating violence. Cyean scholars possess pictographic records dating back to shortly after the departure of the Progenitors, as well as faint memories, passed on genealogically, from shortly before. With an average height of 9 feet (2.75 meters), the Cyeans can be physically imposing but seldom choose to use this to their advantage. Their preference for diplomatic over military solutions to conflict should not be confused with pacifism; their reluctance to start fights is vastly exceeded by their willingness to finish them. A unique part of their anatomy is a so-called 'accessory brain' that allows them to store memories for longer and with greater vividness than other species. Through prolonged physical contact with others (in particular, their offspring), the Cyeans can directly pass on skills they have learned throughout their lives.

Often bitter rivals of their closely-related cousins the Greys, the Empire of the Greens is thought to be the remnants of a distant descendents of a race of overseers left as viceroys by the absent Progenitors.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Little green men" were a stereotypical early portrayal of extraterrestrials as diminutive humanoid-like creatures with green skin and occasionally antennae on their heads. Later, these creatures were more commonly associated with a related alien species called the Greys. During the first flying saucer "sightings" in the 1950s, the term "little green men" came into popular usage in reference to aliens. In one classic case, the Kelly-Hopkinsville sighting on August 21, 1955, two rural Kentucky men described a supposed encounter with 3-4 foot (1 m) tall greenish, somewhat humanoid-looking aliens. Many newspaper articles used the term "little green men" in writing up the story.

Named for their alleged skin tone, Greys are most widely associated with the alien abduction phenomenon, wherein claimants allege that Greys are intelligent extraterrestrials who utilize advanced technology to visit Earth and secretly perform medical experiments on humans they have temporarily kidnapped. A composite description derived from overlap in claims would have Greys as small-bodied, sexless beings with smooth grey skin, enlarged head and large eyes. Since the discovery of the New Worlds, the Greys are thought to be the distant descendents of a race of overseers left as viceroys by the absent Progenitors.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The British science fiction writer H.G. Wells, in his book "The First Men in the Moon" in 1901, first described Selenites, or natives of the Moon, as having gray skin, big heads, and large black eyes. During the early 1980s Greys were linked in popular culture to the alleged crash landing of a flying saucer in Roswell New Mexico, in 1947, by a number of publications which contained statements from individuals who claimed to have seen the U.S. military handling a number of unusually proportioned, bald, child-sized corpses. These individuals claimed that the corpses had over-sized heads and slanted eyes, but scant other facial features, during and after the incident.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Greys are typically depicted as gray-skinned diminutive humanoid beings that possess reduced forms of or outright lack human organs and anatomical components. Their bodies are elongated, having a small chest and lacking in muscular definition and visible skeletal structure. Their legs are shorter and jointed differently than one would expect in a human. Their limbs are proportionally different than a humans; their humerus and thighs are the same lengths as their forearms and shins, respectively. They may have 3-5 fingers and may be depicted as lacking opposable thumbs. Greys have unusually large heads in proportion to their bodies, no hair anywhere on the body, including the face, and no noticeable outer ears or noses, but only small openings or orofices for ears and nostrils. They are depicted as having very small mouths, and very large opaque black eyes with no discernible iris or pupil.

On 22 August 1972, the Victoria Daily Times reported that two local teens claimed to have been chased from the beach at Thetis Lake by a creature which roughly resembled the eponymous Creature from the Black Lagoon. One of the teens claimed to have been slashed across the hand by the creature, which displayed three toes and fingers along with a barbed fin on its skull, prompting an investigation by the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. At the time, the officer stated that "the boys seem sincere, and until we determine otherwise we have no alternative but to continue our investigation."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A day after the story was reported, two other boys claimed to have spotted the creature on the opposite side of the lake from its first appearance. According to one, "it came out of the water and looked around. Then it went back into the water. Then we ran!" The boys described the creature as "shaped like an ordinary body, like a human being's body but it had a monster face, and it was scaly [with] a point sticking out of its head [and] great big ears." They believed the creature had a humanlike face, although it appeared to have scaly and silver-coloured skin. Similar creatures have been reported from places such as Ohio, Delaware, Louisiana, and North Carolina, for at least the last century. They are said to be related to another cryptozoological creature, the chupacabra. Haida mythology from the Queen Charlotte Islands describes a similar creature, with a humanlike face, two tails, and often wears a hat. This creature is often feared by Haida canoeists.

The mid-21st century was a tumultuous time for the subcontinent. Fertilizer shortages, climate collapse, and a limited nuclear exchange with a pre-caliphate Pakistan led to sweeping crop failures. The ensuing famines resulted in the population of the most populous country on Earth falling from a peak of almost two and a half billion to a little over one billion. Combined with the political turmoil instigated by resurgent Hindu nationalist movements leading pogroms against India's Muslim and Buddhist minorities, it is nothing short of a miracle that India has not only persevered, but has become the center of innovation regarding novel agricultural techniques. Nevertheless, the farms and pastures of India are still strained both by the demand of the recovering Indian population and a deteriorating climate. The price of food in India is triple that of other nations on Earth. Many hope that the discovery of the New Worlds will be the key to securing not just Indian, but Terran food security for generations. Familiarity with farming in harsh conditions allows the Indian Colonies to start with an Expert Farmer.

Beset by North Korean terrorism and the growing power of nearby China, Japanese society became increasingly xenophobic and repressive, with the Emperor's [ITALIC]Sonno Joi[\ITALIC] Decree of 2030 entirely closing Japan off from the outside world for the first time since Commodore Perry's 1859 expedition. Since then little is known about life on the heavily fortified islands. The few foreigners allowed in for business reasons report glimpses of astonishingly high technology. and of a roboticized culture that has become increassingly dysfunctional and bizarre. The birth rate has plunged to near-zero, and much of the population is made up of androids. With absolute obedience to the omniscient Emperor masking a grinding stagnation and decay, the Chrysanthemum Throne has authorized an expedition to the New Worlds in a desparate bid for revitalization and growth. The Japanese colonies have difficulty attracting emigrants, but find it easier to purchase cloned or synthetic specialists from the homeworld, and can eventually fabricate some citizen types directly. With the potential to construct advanced robotic facilities that can operate unstaffed, each colony begins with a free Machine Shop.

Initially, Poland prospered after its liberation from Soviet occupation and accession to the European Union. This prosperity was not to last, however, as history has shown time and time again that the people of Poland can never enjoy good times for long. Poland was the nation that put up the strongest resistance to the expanding, authoritarian EU federal government; consequently, millions of European citizens fled their home nations for Poland in pursuit of the freedoms that had slowly eroded over the decades. This increase in population resulted in Poland becoming the most populous country in the EU, with an economy surpassing even that of Germany by 2039. Seeing the writing on the wall, the people of Poland decided to leave the European Union in order to preserve the liberties that were under threat from Brussels. Tragedy would follow as a then-young staff officer in the Polish military orchestrated a coup d'etat, betraying everything the Poles had spent the previous half a century fighting for. The self-styled Sovereignty of Poland boasted of the superficial freedoms retained by its populace, while repressing all meaningful forms of self-expression. Fortifying against a Nanny-State EU in the west and an expansionist Russia in the east, Poland has become increasingly militaristic alongside its libertarian platitudes.

Reptilians (also called Reptiloids or Reptoids) are purported reptilian humanoids that play a prominent role in modern ufology and conspiracy theories.[1] Alien abduction narratives sometimes allege contact with reptilian creatures. One of the earliest reports was that of Ashland, Nebraska police officer Herbert Schirmer, who claims to have been taken aboard a UFO in 1967 by humanoid beings with a slightly reptilian appearance, who bore a "winged serpent" emblem on the left side of their chests.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]According to British writer David Icke, 5 to 12-foot (1.5 - 3.7 m) tall, blood-drinking, shape-shifting reptilian humanoids from the Alpha Draconis star system, now hiding in underground bases in Hollow Earth, are the force behind a worldwide conspiracy directed at humanity. He claims that the reptilians maintain their control through the generation of fear and negative emotion, which is food to these entities, by manufacturing conflicts, primarily wars. American writer Vicki Santillano ranked the notion that "Reptilian humanoids control all of us" as the 10th most popular conspiracy theory.

Bigfoot, also known as Sasquatch, is a supposedly ape-like creature purportedly inhabiting forests, mainly in the Pacific Northwest region of North America. Bigfoot is usually described as a large, hairy, bipedal humanoid. The scientific community considers Bigfoot to be a combination of folklore, misidentification, and hoax, rather than a real creature. In general, mainstream scientific consensus does not support the posited existence of megafauna cryptids such as Bigfoot, because of the improbably large numbers necessary to maintain a breeding population, and because climate and food supply issues would make such purported creatures' survival in reported habitats unlikely. Nevertheless, Bigfoot is one of the more famous examples of a cryptid within cryptozoology.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bigfoot is described in reports as a large hairy ape-like creature, ranging between 6 to 10 feet tall, weighing in excess of 300 pounds (230 kg), and covered in dark brown or dark reddish hair. Alleged witnesses have described large eyes, a pronounced brow ridge, and a large, low-set forehead; the top of the head has been described as rounded and crested, similar to the sagittal crest of the male gorilla. Bigfoot is commonly reported to have a strong, unpleasant smell by those who claim to have encountered it. The enormous footprints for which it is named have been as large as 24 inches (60 cm) long and 8 inches (20 cm) wide. While most casts have five toes, like all known apes, some casts of alleged Bigfoot tracks have had numbers ranging from two to six. Some have also contained claw marks, making it likely that a portion came from known animals such as bears, which have five toes and claws. Proponents have also claimed that Bigfoot is omnivorous and mainly nocturnal.

The Silicoids of the New Worlds are bizarre creatures that appear to be a fusion of organic flesh with various volcanic minerals, and are thought by Earth anthropologists to most closely resemble traditional reports of the Cherufe, an anthropophagous creature in the Mapuche mythology of the South American culture in Chile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Cherufe is an evil creature humanoid of rock and magma. It is said that Cherufe inhabit the magma pools found deep within Chilean volcanoes and are the source of earthquakes and volcanic eruptions. Cherufe are also said to be the source of meteorites and volcanic stones that cause damage in volcanic regions. The only way to abate the Cherufe's appetite for destruction was to satiate the beast's taste for human flesh by throwing a sacrificial victim into the bowels of its volcanic home. Much like the European dragon, the Cherufe's preferred delicacy came in the form of virginal maidens. Legend has it that once the Cherufe was finished consuming the more delicate portions of its victims, it would delight in a macabre game in which it would ignite the disembodied heads of the young girls who were sacrificed to it, and hurtle them from the mouth of its volcanic home. The mythological origins of this beast may have originated to explain anomalies of geological events such as volcanic eruptions.

With growing corruption undermining the rule of law on a global scale, virtually all of Earth's nations are permeated to varying extents by the vast and shadowy criminal organization known as the Syndicate. Syndicate crimelords now exert de facto control over several major metropolitan areas, diverting massive profits from organized crime into the formation of private armies and growing operations in offworld smuggling. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Operating almost entirely in the informal Black Market economy, the Syndicate's bands of offworld smugglers have difficulty selling large volumes of goods into the markets of Earth, but are adept in tax evasion and hiding illicit profits from their grasping superiors. All Syndicate colonies begin with a working Narcotics Lab.
